pitches.logline: Levan is mid-haircut while a tow truck backs up to his white crossover outside. The kiosk woman next door wants to warn him but finds no number on the glass, until she spots the A4 card.
pitches.hook: The kiosk woman shouts down the street as the tow hook clamps onto the crossover's front wheel, sound real-clunk
pitches.heroObject: the tow hook on the wheel

pitches.logline: Giorgi once called a number off a windshield and got angry texts for weeks, so he swore off warning strangers. In a mall car park a car's back door hangs open; this one has a card, and scanning it costs him nothing.
pitches.hook: Giorgi yells into the empty concrete car park at a hatchback whose rear door hangs open, sound real-door

pitches.logline: Dato did not want his number on show, so he put his mum's number behind the windshield. Every neighbour his car blocks now rings her, and she rings him, angrier each time.
pitches.hook: Mum's number on the car freezes as his phone buzzes and she yells, sound real-phone-buzz
pitches.heroObject: the paper note with mum's number

treatment.logline: Dato did not want his number on show, so he put his mum's number behind the windshield. Every neighbour his car blocks rings her, and she rings him, angrier each time, until he swaps the note for the QR card with no number.
treatment.hero: Dato (told as 'me'), his dark blue sedan by the courtyard gate; mum only heard through the phone
treatment.heroObject: the paper note with mum's number
treatment.obstacle: he wants no stranger to have his number, yet whoever his car blocks must reach someone

hook.event: mum's number on the car freezes, the phone buzzes and mum yells that they are calling her about his car again; the call count climbs

act1: Monday 10:00: someone cannot get out of the courtyard and rings mum
dinner: mum rings again and calls him თავქარიანი for writing her number
Sunday 07:00: the third call wakes mum, then Dato
treatment.turn: Dato tears the note in two; the torn paper shape matches into the phone

reveal.what: home, the menu, QR ბარათი: the card the app makes

screens.step: settings left at ნომრის გარეშე, print on A4
whoever is blocked scans and taps a reason

treatment.payoff: the push comes to Dato, not to mum; he texts her to go back to sleep
treatment.signature: the note with mum's number torn off, then the printed card cut on its dashed line and set behind the same glass
